body:
@stau Can you show me the test code you made? 
I suspect `AssertionError` occurs when `FixedChannelPool::decrementAndRunTaskQueue()` is called after `FixedChannelPool::close()`.
@fratboy @stau I think in this case we may want to just close the Channel ?

@normanmaurer By closing subsequent Channels, would it mean that the FixedChannelPool will remain in the "closed" state forever? The current implementation seems to be resetting the FixedChannelPool rather than closing it permanently.
@stau yes it should stay closed forever

@stau I think we should not call `pool.release(ch)` after call `pool.close()`. 
@normanmaurer  Is it better to set promise failed when a user call `pool.acquire` or `pool.release` after call `pool.close` ?

@fratboy This shouldn't occur in normal circumstances, however when attempting to (best effort) clean up after an Exception, the pool may be closed before an acquired Channel is released. For example having a handler which releases a Channel after an operation is complete.
@fratboy yeah failing with an exception would be fine as well. Let me fix it.
